entities.summary: Nathan French is a British volleyball player. French was born in Chelmsford, Essex and he competed for Great Britain at the 2012 Summer Olympics. French was the youngest member of the men’s team and started playing the sport in school when he was 13. French has also played professionally in Spain, France, Germany and Israel.
